notes.title: OrangePixel releases Regulators - A unique single player action shooter that plays and feels like a co-op multiplayer game.
notes.content:
Pl[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/9856238/e2a9c85834e36da21e9d25463d698b44c9de18e6.jpg[/img]

The new OrangePixel game Regulators is NOW available, please come check it out:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1892750/Regulators/


REGULATORS puts you in charge of a small squad of mercenaries hired to clear the city from mutating villains in this top-down tactical shooter game. 
Enter buildings from the streets, rooftops or sewers, and complete mission goals to locate the scientist commanding the mutating villains. And take them all out!

A unique single player real-time action game that feels like a co-op multiplayer game with NPC-mercenaries following the player’s lead.

notes.title: Gauntlet of Power Patch 4: The Temple and the Rogue
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/9856238/0b247cbcf9759b91fa6e46431fc13a77875890ed.jpg[/img]

The new update for Heroes of Loot: Gauntlet of Power is now live! 

[h1]New Content:[/h1]

– Hidden realm: The Temple
– New unlockable character: The Rogue
– New friendlies
– New enemies

Grab the update now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2374320/Heroes_Of__Loot_Gauntlet_Of_Power/

[h2]More info:[/h2]

Besides adding the new realm and characters, I made some small changes to balancing things out (especially for the easy mode).

I also made the realms more of a choice to go into or not, as it will mean you now skip one or two levels. So if you are in a hurry and want to speedrun the game, knowing where to find the entries to these realms is certainly key.. but I can imagine it might sometimes be more interesting to NOT take the realm-route and grab some extra loot in the levels you would otherwise skip.

If you need a little spoiler on how/where to find the Rogue unlock tokens, make sure to check the Orangepixel website for the Games Wiki.

notes.content:

notes.title: Come play: Sir Questionnaire
notes.content:
Hi guys! Just wanted to let you know that I just pushed the release button on a new Orangepixel Steam release:  Sir Questionnaire!

It's a quirky game at a bargain price, it provides hours of gameplay in a VERY small package:  The game is played in single dungeon rooms, where you are given the choice to either "interact" or "get outta there!".

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9856238/31225943fe2d8e4c0b171ac3119acb2f38bb5b22.gif[/img]

Do you attack the skulls? got enough health? got the right weapon for the lobsters? Got some magic left to hit the huge Wolf on his head? Dare to drink the milk before the next encounter? 

A game of choices - how far can you venture into the dungeon?  Come play Sir Questionnaire, and make sure to drop by on discord if you need tips & tricks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2124790/Sir_Questionnaire

[b]RESIDUAL[/b] is a survival platformer offering a combination of crafting and exploration. There are no weapons, it's just you, the planet, and an adventure for survival that's different every time you hit the "New Game" option.

[b]RESIDUAL[/b] throws you onto a procedurally generated planet with no humanoid lifeforms. Your task? Survive! – Explore the planet both above and below ground, scavenge, mine, craft, fish, pluck, chop, climb, jump, push, pull, and solve puzzles along the way.

notes.title: Controller and fullscreen bugs squashed
notes.content:
The latest update fixes a bunch of (all?) controller issues, no controller-setup is required now as it will support the most common controllers out of the box.

If you have a controller which remains undetected, make sure to contact support - at - orangepixel dotnet  and we can see about adding support for it.

Fixes:
 - Xbox 360 controller now detected and correctly configured
 - Resizing / Fullscreening / Windowing will keep controller active
 - Mac version now won't crash when controllers are attached

notes.content:

Every day a new leaderboard is created, so every time you will be able to show your speed-running skills by completing the Daily in the shortest time!

The update also pushes some new changes for controller support as I continue to try and squash all the controller problems.

See you on the Daily boards! ;)

notes.title: Trading cards, badges, leaderboard, fixes, and improvements
notes.content:
[img]http://techblog.orangepixel.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/gs2_steam_tradingcards.png[/img]

I finally managed to get this update ready for shipping. 

There are now leaderboards (in-game) for Arcade-mode and a "completed Daily run" board that shows who the best daily challenger is.

Further more the requested Steam trading-cards with badges and everything that comes with that have been activated, so you can now collect a few trading-cards and see if you can unlock some cool badges.

Also added a host of fixes and improvements to the game, controller support and more. Here's the full list of things:

[list]
[*] added leaderboards arcade mode
[*] fixed some rendering issues
[*] fixed controller disconnecting when switching fullscreen
[*] added “best runners” leaderboard to daily mode
[*] added trading cards and badges 
[*] added fullscreen toggle to the in-game setup room
[*] added option for VSync (see in-game setup room)
[*] fixed “top of stairs” bug in buildings
[*] fixed “rescue+die” bug in buildings
[*] fixed General P.Hat end-boss bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3.0 - Statistics
notes.content:
[img]http://techblog.orangepixel.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/gs2_statistics.png[/img]

A new update with some minor fixes and changes. For those with sound issues (where the music just stopped) let me know if this fixed it, or if it at least happens less often.

New addition are statistics for the daily challenge, the screen stays a bit longer so you can grab (and post) screenshots from your Daily Challenge results.

The statistics show the amount of runs you tried before completing it, the time of the completion run, and the total time put into the completion.

Make sure to check the OrangePixel Youtube channel for the "daily challenge" videos:   [url]https://www.youtube.com/user/orangepixelmobile[/url]


Full change list:
[list]
	[*] added: “try count” to daily challenge result
	[*] added: “total time taken” to daily challenge result
	[*] fixed: cloning yourself when jumping in tank+turret at same spot
	[*] fixed: “score achievements” no longer given during daily challenge
	[*] fixed: input setup would sometimes not be saved correctly
	[*] fixed: attempted to fix PC sound issues (where sound just stops)
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - Daily Challenges
notes.content:
[img]http://techblog.orangepixel.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/gs2_update_DailyChallenge.png[/img]

Daily challenges are here!  

You'll find a new door in the game hub and it's will supply you with a challenging level every day!  You have one life, one level, and one day to complete it. Everybody gets the same level, so see if you can beat your friends !

The Daily challenges also come with new achievements for 1, 5, 10 and 30 challenge completions, so make sure to beat the Daily challenges every day to unlock those!


Full change list:
[list]
[*] added Daily-challenge (beta, no achievements yet)
[*] arcade mode now unlocks when you reach world 3
[*] added Arcade-mode unlock achievement
[*] added bunch of new achievements for daily challenges
[*] player restarts closer to arcade/daily challenge doors
[*] statusbar now flashes when health is improved (in vehicles for example)
[*] fixed "game over" screen in arcade mode
[*] fixed: made wall turrets world 7 bit easier (in story mode)
[*] fixed: show message when touching locked arcade door
[/list]

notes.title: Daily challenges
notes.content:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/B7ks1YbCEAAovET.png[/img]

I plan to upload a new build in a few days with various small improvements, changes, fixes and a "Beta" of the Daily Challenges mode. 

[h1]Daily challenges explained[/h1]

The Daily Challenge is a single building level, that you'll get to complete only once a day. The current test levels are pretty hard tho, so you should have a very nice challenge in them, and that's kinda the point!

Everybody has the same daily challenge level, but the way you play it (shoot a soldier or let him live) can change the outcome of the level.. so it's worth trying different tactics!

The first version won't have achievements attached yet, until I'm sure everything works as it should.

Later I'll add achievements for completing X amount of challenges, so you got something to aim for ;)

notes.title: Gunslugs 2 released, now what?
notes.content:
[img]http://techblog.orangepixel.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/gs2_denise_ready2play.png[/img]

Hope you guys are enjoying the game!  If you run into problems or glitches please let me know in the forums.  I might not respond to everything, but I do read most things and will look into either fixing any bugs or taking a good look at ideas and changes you guys think could improve the game.

I have some minor update ideas on my list, but I also have a bigger update that will hopefully give you guys even more play-time with this game.

I'll be putting some time into adding "Daily challenges", basically it will be a one-tower level and you get one life, one weapon, and a task to destroy the tower.  I will add achievements for completing daily challenges, multiple challenges, etc.

So stay tuned as I work towards the first update, and enjoy the game ;)
